component.name: FoxTune
component.summary: Open source ECU tuning for Speeduino and rusEFI

description.p: FoxTune tunes Speeduino and rusEFI engine control units. It learns each ECU from its own TunerStudio definition - the settings, tables and live data it has - so it keeps up with firmware updates rather than hardcoding them.

ul.li: Connects over USB serial or TCP, and finds the exact firmware's definition
A live dashboard of dials, bars, lamps and time graphs you arrange
Table and curve editing, with a 3D view of each table
Settings screens generated from the ECU's definition
VE autotuning from live wideband data
Writes verified by the ECU's own checksum before burning
Reads and writes .msq tunes, and logs to .msl
